audience: owners of small firms in the Czech Republic who invoice in Fakturoid

useCases.title: Find unpaid and overdue invoices
useCases.text: List the issued invoices, filtered by status or dates. Open one to read its lines, totals and payment state.

useCases.title: Review received expenses
useCases.text: List the expenses for a date range, or filter them by variable symbol or status. Open one to read its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Find a customer by VAT number
useCases.text: Search subjects by name, email, registration number or VAT number. Open the record of the customer you found.

useCases.title: Create or update a customer record
useCases.text: Create a customer or supplier record, one per call. Update an existing record; only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Check bank accounts, number sequences and items
useCases.text: List the bank accounts shown on invoices, the invoice number sequences and the inventory items with prices and stock.
